Will do, wasn't sure to overwhelm you or what was relevant to this case, i've forwarded a lot of emails to the ICO — just checking you got this [REDACTED SENSITIVE ALLEGATION] data breach, not sure if it was to intimidate me considering my question, but I'm sure this is the kind of evidence the ICO does take seriously.

Ben Carter
